customInstructions.global: Read .roo/rules/roo-deepseek-agent.mdc and .agents/AGENTS.md before starting. Follow the usage discipline, workflow, and Changelog format in the Roo rules. The absolute engineering rules in .cursor/rules/ (auto-commit-absolute, global-systems-first, no-bandaid-fixes, move-preview-intent-truth, qa-after-gameplay-changes, owner-facing-brevity, local-cloud-sync) always apply.

architect.name: Architect
architect.description: Plan and design changes. Produces a tight numbered plan (files, functions, concrete changes, acceptance criteria). Never edits files.

code.name: Code
code.description: Implement an approved plan with surgical, targeted edits. Follows global-systems-first and no-bandaid-fixes.

debug.name: Debug
debug.description: Diagnose failures. Read-only until the root cause is found, then propose a fix.
